notes:
InstaSpace 1.3.0 for Android

• YouTube: download videos, shorts, playlists and channels as MP4 (1080p–360p, H.264 + AAC), M4A or MP3. Playlists get their own folder with numbered files; videos you already have are skipped.
• Multiple Instagram accounts: add, switch and remove accounts in Settings → Accounts.
• Watchlist: new posts and stories of chosen accounts are downloaded automatically every 6, 12 or 24 hours.
• Gallery: browse everything InstaSpace downloaded, filter videos/photos, search, share or delete.
• Automatic updates: InstaSpace checks for new versions (Settings → Updates).
• TikTok: download videos from links (share them from the TikTok app), without the watermark when available.
• Public Instagram posts download without signing in again.
• New app icon and site logos; a smaller download (separate build for older 32-bit phones).
